# Celestial Data

> Celestial datasets in GeoJSON and GeoPackage format, derived from d3-celestial and processed with R and sf by Diego Hernangómez.

The objects describe the J2000 epoch and include stars, constellations, asterisms, deep-sky objects and the Milky Way. The project represents these objects as geographic geometries in EPSG:4326, bounded by [-180, -90, 180, 90]. This representation does not turn the datasets into terrestrial observations or current celestial positions. GeoJSON files also have minified variants.

The original d3-celestial data is attributed to Olaf Frohn. Consult the repository license and citation metadata when reusing the data.

## Data and citation

- [Data files](https://github.com/dieghernan/celestial_data/tree/main/data): GeoJSON, GeoPackage and supporting CSV files.
- [Milky Way GeoJSON](https://dieghernan.github.io/celestial_data/data/mw.min.geojson): A directly downloadable example.
- [Citation metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dieghernan/celestial_data/main/CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation information.
